color.note: Night is the primary theme: the projector, the captain's phone in a dim hall. Day is for admin laptops and print. One accent (gold) means 'now'; status colours carry a word every time.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page and stage background. The stage screen is always night.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, table body, the captain's bid sheet.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hover rows, menus, the active player card on the stage.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and panels. Decorative only, never a control's only edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders, progress-bar tracks' edge; 3:1 on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numerals on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels (BASE PRICE, AGE), metadata, table headers on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The one accent: current bid, leading team, primary action, focus. As text on ground, surface, surface-raised and gold-soft.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind gold text: the leading team's purse row, the live player's tile.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a gold fill (primary button, bid button).

tokens.name: sold
tokens.usage: SOLD status, stamp and badge; teal leans off the red-green axis. As text on the surfaces and sold-soft.

tokens.name: sold-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind sold text: sold badge, sold rows.

tokens.name: on-sold
tokens.usage: Text on a sold fill.

tokens.name: unsold
tokens.usage: UNSOLD status: neutral, not an error. As text on the surfaces and unsold-soft.

tokens.name: unsold-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind unsold text.

tokens.name: retained
tokens.usage: RETAINED and pre-assigned players (captains, icons). As text on the surfaces and retained-soft.

tokens.name: retained-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind retained text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, purse exceeded, undo-sale confirm. As text on the surfaces and danger-soft. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger text: error fields, blocked bid.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (destructive button).

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: The LIVE dot and the last five seconds of the countdown. Alias of danger.

tokens.name: team-1
tokens.usage: Default team colour slot 1 (blue). Bars and dots beside a team code, never text, never the only cue. Tournaments override with their own.

tokens.name: team-2
tokens.usage: Default team colour slot 2 (orange). Bars and dots only.

tokens.name: team-3
tokens.usage: Default team colour slot 3 (teal). Bars and dots only.

tokens.name: team-4
tokens.usage: Default team colour slot 4 (rose). Bars and dots only.

tokens.name: team-5
tokens.usage: Default team colour slot 5 (violet). Bars and dots only.

tokens.name: team-6
tokens.usage: Default team colour slot 6 (mustard). Bars and dots only.

tokens.name: team-7
tokens.usage: Default team colour slot 7 (green). Bars and dots only.

tokens.name: team-8
tokens.usage: Default team colour slot 8 (brick). Bars and dots only.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in admin and docs. Alias of gold.

type.note: Barlow Condensed carries every name and number; Barlow carries reading text. Teko sits second in the display stack only to draw the rupee sign and Devanagari names Barlow lacks. Use tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) for every price and stat.

groups.name: Stage
groups.note: Sized for a 1920 x 1080 canvas scaled to the projector. Readable from the back row: nothing on the stage is smaller than stage-label.

styles.name: stage-price
styles.usage: The current bid. One per screen.

styles.name: stage-name
styles.usage: Player on the block; the SOLD stamp word.

styles.name: stage-stat
styles.usage: Stat numerals and the countdown seconds.

styles.name: stage-title
styles.usage: Tournament name, panel titles. Set uppercase.

styles.name: stage-label
styles.usage: Labels above stage numbers. Set uppercase, ink-muted.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Names and numbers in the admin, captain and audience apps.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one big figure on a phone: purse left, current bid.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Prices and counts in cards, rows and purse bars.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, table player names, dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Captains bid from their phones. The auctioneer confirms every sale.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata under names, hints under fields.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, table headers, badge text. Set uppercase.

spacing.note: 4px base. Stage layouts use the top three steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, dot to word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges and chips; between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside buttons and inputs; between rows of a stat grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding in admin; between sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Stage panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between stage panels.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Stage outer margin on the 1920 canvas.

radius.note: Square-shouldered, like a scoreboard. Only the live dot and avatars are round.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Role chips, team code bars, the SOLD stamp.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Stage panels and phone bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Live dot, player avatars, progress-bar ends.

shadow.note: Night leans on borders, not shadows. Day uses two soft elevations.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards and inputs at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the SOLD stamp overlay, menus.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px ground-coloured gap, then 2px of solid gold. Box-shadow, so it follows the radius.

breakpoint.note: Fluid layouts between these; the stage is a fixed canvas scaled to fit.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: Captain and audience apps: one column below this.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Auctioneer console on a tablet: two columns from here.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Admin: sidebar plus table from here.

tokens.name: bp-stage
tokens.usage: The stage canvas width; scale it to the viewport, never reflow it.

tokens.name: layer-ticker
tokens.usage: Sales ticker and live bar on the stage.

tokens.name: layer-sheet
tokens.usage: Phone bottom sheets.

tokens.name: layer-overlay
tokens.usage: SOLD / UNSOLD stamp over the stage.

tokens.name: layer-dialog
tokens.usage: Confirm dialogs (undo sale, end auction).
